items.t: S-10 Blazer: automatic transmission slips or loses gears
items.job: Rebuild or replace 4L60-E automatic transmission
items.note: Owners report about $2,400 on average.

items.t: S-10 Blazer: intake manifold gasket leaks coolant
items.job: Replace intake manifold gaskets and coolant
items.note: Change the oil too if coolant got into it.

items.t: S-10 Blazer: central "spider" fuel injector sticks or leaks
items.job: Replace central (spider) fuel injector assembly

items.t: S-10 Blazer: fuel pump failure
items.job: Replace in-tank fuel pump module
items.note: Owners report about $700 total.

items.t: S-10 Blazer: fuel gauge reads wrong
items.job: Replace fuel level sender or pump module
items.note: Owners report about $650 total.

items.t: S-10 Blazer: upper ball joint can separate (recall)
items.job: Free dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if not already done. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: S-10 Blazer: gauges stop working
items.job: Rebuild instrument cluster or replace gauge motors

items.t: S-10 Blazer: ABS light on from failed brake control module
items.job: Replace ABS electronic brake control module
items.note: A wheel speed sensor costs much less if that's the cause.

items.t: S-10 Blazer: blower works only on some speeds
items.job: Replace blower motor resistor (and motor if worn)

items.t: S-10 Blazer: doors sag from worn hinge pins
items.job: Replace door hinge pins and bushings (one door)

items.t: S-10 Blazer: oil pressure gauge drops or jumps
items.job: Replace oil pressure sender

items.t: S-10 Blazer: misfire from distributor cap and rotor
items.job: Replace distributor cap, rotor and spark plug wires

items.t: S-10 Blazer: brake lights and hazards can stop working (recall)
items.job: Free dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if not already done. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: S-10 Blazer: windshield wipers work on and off (recall)
items.job: Free dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if not already done. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: S-10 Blazer: seat belt webbing may separate (recall)
items.job: Free dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if not already done. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: S-10 Blazer: rear brake pipe or control arm nuts (recalls)
items.job: Free dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if not already done. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Crossover: transmission shudder or harsh shifts
items.job: Transmission fluid drain and refill, adaptive relearn
items.note: Often covered under the powertrain warranty.

items.t: Crossover: transmission fluid leak from missing bolts (recall)
items.job: Free dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if not already done. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Crossover: tire sidewall or belt can fail (recall)
items.job: Free dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if not already done. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Crossover: roof-rail airbag inflator can come apart (recall)
items.job: Free dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if not already done. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Crossover: seat belts held with the wrong bolts (recall)
items.job: Free dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if not already done. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Crossover: driver seat frame weld may be weak (recall)
items.job: Free dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if not already done. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Crossover: front axle shaft can come apart (recalls)
items.job: Free dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if not already done. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Crossover: door strikers can break (recall)
items.job: Free dealer recall repair
items.note: Free at a Chevrolet dealer if not already done. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Crossover: "Shift to Park" message and won't turn off
items.job: Repair or replace shifter park switch/shifter assembly
items.note: Owners report about $620.

items.t: Crossover: several warning messages at once
items.job: Test/replace 12V battery and add battery tray bracket fix

items.t: Crossover: starter grinds or spins without cranking
items.job: Replace starter; replace flex plate if teeth are broken
items.note: Flex plate replacement means removing the transmission, which is the high end.

items.t: Crossover: water leaks inside or liftgate acting up
items.job: Find and seal water leak; replace liftgate actuator if damaged

items.t: Crossover: check engine light from the crankcase pressure sensor
items.job: Replace or reseat crankcase pressure sensor per GM bulletin

items.t: Crossover: transmission case leak or clutch ring defect (GM programs)
items.job: Free GM program repair (case replacement or clutch housing overhaul)
items.note: Done free under the GM service program.

items.t: Crossover: front brake caliper bracket can crack (GM program)
items.job: Free GM program repair (replace both front caliper brackets)
items.note: Done free under the GM service program.

items.t: Crossover: "Service Safety Restraint" airbag warning
items.job: Diagnose airbag system per GM bulletin
items.note: Usually covered by the new-vehicle warranty.
